import React,{useEffect,useMemo,useState} from 'react';
import {createRoot} from 'react-dom/client';
import {RecallPlugin} from '../../app/plugin-recall.tsx';
import {createLearningDraftStore} from '../../app/learning-draft-store.ts';
import {LearningDraftBoundary} from '../../app/learning-draft.tsx';
import {createNonWordSession} from '../../src/application/nonword-study/index.ts';
import {createLocalAttemptRepository,attemptFingerprint,evaluationFingerprint} from '../../src/infrastructure/learning-attempt/index.ts';
import '../../app/globals.css';
import '../../app/c-study.css';
const query=new URLSearchParams(location.search),mode=query.get('mode');
document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark',query.get('theme')==='dark');
const binding={ownerId:'synthetic-owner',libraryId:'synthetic-library',snapshotId:'synthetic-snapshot',
  itemKey:'synthetic-question',contentHash:'a'.repeat(64),groupId:'synthetic-group',roundId:'synthetic-round'};
const repository=createLocalAttemptRepository({userId:binding.ownerId,libraryId:binding.libraryId});
const session=createNonWordSession({repository,binding,attemptId:'synthetic-first',formalEventId:'synthetic-formal',
  mode:'recall',purpose:'first',now:()=>new Date().toISOString(),newId:()=>crypto.randomUUID(),fingerprint:attemptFingerprint,evaluationFingerprint});
const probe={calls:[],read:()=>repository.read('synthetic-first')};
Object.assign(window,{__nonwordProbe:probe});
const data={itemId:'synthetic-question',fingerprint:binding.contentHash,questionType:'recall',
  prompt:'为什么修改需求后要核对相关测试？',answer:'需求变化可能影响原来的行为，因此需核对相关测试。',
  explanation:'需求变化可能影响原来的行为，因此需核对相关测试。',
  learningSupport:{schemaVersion:1,type:'recall',criteria:[{id:'p',text:'需求变化可能影响原来的行为。'}]}};
function App(){
  const store=useMemo(()=>createLearningDraftStore('synthetic-browser'),[]),[ready,setReady]=useState(false),[done,setDone]=useState(false),[error,setError]=useState('');
  const draft=store.adapter('synthetic-question','recall:1');
  useEffect(()=>{let live=true;session.open().then(state=>{if(!live)return;
    if(state.submitted){draft.write('answer',state.submitted.answer);if(state.evaluation.status==='pending')draft.write('nonwordPending','原回答已保存，等待核对。');draft.markInputRecovered(draft.inputRevision());}
    setReady(true);
  }).catch(value=>setError(String(value)));return()=>{live=false;};},[]);
  if(error)return <p role="alert">{error}</p>;
  if(!ready)return <p>正在恢复</p>;
  if(done)return <h2>已继续，答案待核对</h2>;
  const lifecycle={ready:true,purpose:'first',intent:'review',get submitted(){return Boolean(session.snapshot()?.submitted);},
    async recordHint(policy){const revision=draft.inputRevision();await session.save(draft.read('answer',''),{
      ...session.snapshot().checkpoint.pluginFields,hintLevel:String(policy.maxPreHintLevel),policyAttemptId:policy.attemptId});
      draft.markInputRecovered(revision);},
    async submit(answer){const revision=draft.inputRevision();probe.calls.push('submit');await session.submit(answer);draft.markInputRecovered(revision);},
    async assess(outcome){probe.calls.push('assess');await session.assess(outcome);},
    async waitForReview(){probe.calls.push('pending');await session.pending('offline');},
    async continuePending(){await session.traversePending();setDone(true);}};
  const gradeRecall=async()=>{probe.calls.push('ai');return {source:'ai',verdict:mode==='zero'?'correct':mode,
    rating:mode==='zero'||mode==='correct'?'good':mode==='partial'?'hard':'again',
    matchedPointIds:mode==='zero'||mode==='incorrect'?[]:['p'],missedPointIds:mode==='zero'||mode==='incorrect'?['p']:[],
    feedback:'依据合成参考核对。'};};
  return <main className="study-app study-focus"><section className="workspace">
    <LearningDraftBoundary store={store} interactiveWhileGrading><RecallPlugin.renderUI data={data}
      context={{draft,nonWordLearning:lifecycle,gradeRecall,guidanceInOptions:true,recallPersistenceRequired:false,
        recallNavigation:{continueLabel:'结束本轮',onSkip:()=>{probe.calls.push('skip');setDone(true);}}}}
      onGrade={()=>{probe.calls.push('formal');}}/></LearningDraftBoundary>
  </section></main>;
}
createRoot(document.getElementById('root')).render(<App/>);
